description: Header file defining the ApplicationAndroid class for Android applications within the Starboard framework. It manages Android app lifecycle, input events, window handling, and resource overlays.

classes.name: ApplicationAndroid
classes.description: Manages Android application lifecycle, input, and window events, and resource overlays within the Starboard framework.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ApplicationAndroid.

methods.name: CreateWindow
methods.description: Creates a new application window with specified options.

methods.name: DestroyWindow
methods.description: Destroys the specified application window.

methods.name: OnSearchRequested
methods.description: Handles search request events.

methods.name: HandleDeepLink
methods.description: Processes a deep link URL.

methods.name: SendTTSChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a Text-to-Speech settings changed event.

methods.name: SendAndroidCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the Android application with specified type and data.

methods.name: SendAndroidMotionEvent
methods.description: Sends a motion event to the application.

methods.name: SendAndroidKeyEvent
methods.description: Sends a key event to the application.

methods.name: SendKeyboardInject
methods.description: Injects a keyboard key event.

methods.name: SbWindowSendInputEvent
methods.description: Sends input text or composition state.

methods.name: SendLowMemoryEvent
methods.description: Notifies about low memory conditions.

methods.name: OsNetworkStatusChange
methods.description: Notifies network status changes.

methods.name: app_start_with_android_fix
methods.description: Returns the application start timestamp with Android-specific fix.

methods.name: SendDateTimeConfigurationChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a date/time configuration change event.

methods.name: GetOverlayedIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer resource overlay variable.

methods.name: GetOverlayedStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string resource overlay variable.

methods.name: GetOverlayedBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean resource overlay variable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the application.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Cleans up the application.

methods.name: IsStartImmediate
methods.description: Indicates if the application should start immediately.

methods.name: OnResume
methods.description: Handles application resume event.

methods.name: OnSuspend
methods.description: Handles application suspend event.

methods.name: MayHaveSystemEvents
methods.description: Checks if system events are available.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a system event with a timeout.

methods.name: WakeSystemEventWait
methods.description: Wakes the system event wait.

methods.name: ProcessAndroidCommand
methods.description: Processes queued Android commands.

methods.name: ProcessKeyboardInject
methods.description: Processes keyboard injection events.
